summary: Validated iter18 site-switches batch (Settings tab + 7 admin flags + beta feedback + idle-clear + hard-clear). Backend pytest: 16/16 PASS. Frontend Playwright: SettingsTab renders all 12 expected testids, admin-tab-settings present, every switch row + danger card + feedback inbox + filter chips visible. Public maintenance/beta/apply gates all confirmed to flip live via PATCH + cross-tab reload. WS rejection on live_chat_enabled=false confirmed (admin-only auth check passes). Settings restored to defaults. No critical bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/settings.py is clean: pydantic validation on idle_clear_minutes (5..1440), proper 400 on empty PATCH, 403 on feedback when beta_mode=false, 404 on unknown feedback id, _id stripped from admin GET response. Good.
MaintenanceGate bypass list `["/admin", "/maker"]` is correct and prevents operator lockout — confirmed by Playwright (mp_admin == 0 even with maintenance_mode=true).
useSiteSettings.js singleton+listener pattern is fine but `_listeners = new Set()` and `_cache = null` are module-globals — acceptable but noteworthy if SSR/hydration gets added.
BetaBanner.jsx coerces detail array to fallback string (avoids the iter17 React-child crash) — good defensive code.
SettingsTab.jsx is ~436 lines (under 700 LOC limit). HardClearCard double-confirm UX is correctly two-stage (step 0→1→2). Cancel buttons reset to step 0.

chat_cleanup.py uses ISO-string string-comparison for cutoff — works because all created_at are stored as ISO 8601 UTC with consistent format. If the format ever changes (e.g. dropping timezone), comparisons silently break. Consider parsing.
Channel list expansion to 11 channels is consistent: backend CHANNELS set in routers/community.py matches frontend chat-channel-{c} testids.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testid presence + maintenance/beta/apply/live-chat/idle-clear/hard-clear-double-confirm UI flows verified

test_credentials: Admin JWT minted via maker_auth.issue_session_jwt('admin','team@craftersmarket.org', role='admin'); seed in localStorage.cm_admin_jwt before /admin/dashboard.
seed_data_creation: 1 beta_feedback row created (TEST_betauser / TEST_FEEDBACK_MSG_iter18) during pytest, then resolved in same test. Cleanup not needed — id is unique. No production data altered. Settings restored to defaults at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend coverage for site-settings is in /app/backend/tests/test_settings.py (16 tests, ~4s runtime). Covers: public GET, admin auth, PATCH round-trip, idle-minutes ge/le validation, empty-PATCH 400, beta-feedback 403/200, admin inbox+resolve+404, apply gate 403/non-403, idle-clear endpoint, hard-clear auth-only (NOT firing destructive call), WS rejection, 11-channel registry. Settings always restored to defaults via module-scoped autouse fixture. Frontend testids verified rendering: settings-tab, setting-row-{maintenance_mode,beta_mode,allow_maker_applications,live_chat_enabled,auto_clear_idle_rooms}, hard-clear-card, idle-clear-now-card, feedback-inbox, feedback-filter-{open,resolved,all}, hard-clear-confirm-{1,2}, idle-clear-now-result. NOT executed: actual hard-clear (would wipe real chat). NOT executed: WebSocket connect happy-path with buyer JWT (auth gate verified at handshake but full message round-trip skipped). The Playwright cross-tab reload pattern works — admin PATCH then ctx.new_page() to load public route fetches fresh /api/settings without waiting 60s.
